d:
Krisha Ballabh Sahay, known as KB Sahay, was 3rd Chief Minister of Bihar. His intention to abolish Zamindari System had made a chaotic situation in Bihar as well as Congress Party. His feud with landlords, especially Raja Ramgarh Kamakhya Narayan Singh, over Land reforms and the abolition of Zamindari system were catching the headlines in the 50s and 60s. Watch this latest episode of The Lallantop's special political series named Mukhyamantri by Editor Saurabh Dwivedi for more details.
